name: Cabbage Casserole
description: A creamy cabbage casserole with a crunchy bread crumb topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cabbage wedges until tender, then drain and cut into large pieces.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Season with salt, grated cheese, and Cheez Whiz.
Combine cooked cabbage with the white sauce mixture.
Top with crumbled buttered bread.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

keywords: cabbage casserole, creamy vegetable dish, comforting main course

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Supreme Broccoli Soup Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole with a crunchy crouton topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Place cooked broccoli in a 9x9 inch pan.
Mix together mushroom soup, flour, sour cream, and seasonings. Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle grated carrot, chopped onion, and croutons over the top.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 325°F for 1/2 hour.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, creamy soup casserole, baked vegetable dish

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Ham & Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A layered ham, potato, and cheese casserole cooked in a slow cooker.
recipeIngredient: Cream of mushroom or celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Put half of the ham, potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker.
Add the remaining half of the ingredients for the second layer.
Top with soup and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook on slow for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish
